title.value: An act to add Chapter 13.5 (commencing with Section 108970) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health

reference.provenance: Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.

date.provenance: Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) defined as: Any substance that contains at least one fully fluorinated methyl (CF3-) or methylene (-CF2-) carbon atom (without any H/Cl/Br/I attached to it). A substance that only contains the following structural elements is excluded from the scope of the proposed restriction: CF3-X or X-CF2-X’, where X = -OR or -NRR’ and X’ = methyl (-CH3), methylene (-CH2-), an aromatic group, a carbonyl group (-C(O)-), -OR’’, -SR’’ or –NR’’R’’’, and where R/R’/R’’/R’’’ is a hydrogen (-H), methyl (-CH3), methylene (-CH2-), an aromatic group or a carbonyl group (-C(O)-).

type.provenance: commencing January 1, 2025, prohibits manufacturing, distributing, selling, or offering for sale in the state any new, not previously owned, textile articles that contain regulated PFAS

who.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles

action.provenance: prohibits manufacturing, distributing, selling, or offering for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles

products.provenance: commencing January 1, 2025, no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles

value: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions until January 1, 2028
exceptions.provenance: Paragraph (1) does not apply to outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions until January 1, 2028

intentionally_added.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS means either of the following: (1) PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product
